answer: Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity anchored to scarce physical attestations: each agent must bond tokens and register a unique hardware root whose provenance is verified by independent witnesses. Forging many identities then costs real capital plus scarce devices, making mass fakery uneconomic. Think of an island community where each resident plants a willow marking a limestone karst spring; duplicating a marker is cheap, but duplicating the spring and its witnesses is not.
